dialogues.jp: しかしな……。
dialogues.en: Yet...
dialogues.text: Yet...

dialogues.jp:
電気も点けず、ベッドの上で天井を見上げなが
ら、工藤の事を考えていた。
dialogues.en:
With the lights switched on, I stared at the ceiling while
lying on my bed, thinking of Kudou.
dialogues.text:
With the lights switched on, I stared at the ceiling while
lying on my bed, thinking of Kudou.

dialogues.jp: 昼間のあれは、夢か幻か……。
dialogues.en: Maybe what I saw at lunch break was an illusion...
dialogues.text: Maybe what I saw at lunch break was an illusion...

dialogues.jp:
結局、工藤があの後、教室に姿を見せることは
なかった。
dialogues.en: Since after that, Kudou never returned to class.
dialogues.text: Since after that, Kudou never returned to class.

dialogues.jp: 時間が経つたびにだんだんと確証が薄れていく。
dialogues.en:
As time passed, I started doubting whether what I saw was
the truth.
dialogues.text:
As time passed, I started doubting whether what I saw was
the truth.

dialogues.jp:
ピンクのクマなんか見ているような俺だ。幻覚
だったのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
I see pink bears after all. It wouldn't be too much of a
stretch to call that a hallucination.
dialogues.text:
I see pink bears after all. It wouldn't be too much of a
stretch to call that a hallucination.

dialogues.jp: いや、だが……確かにこの目で……。
dialogues.en: No, but... I saw it with my own eyes...
dialogues.text: No, but... I saw it with my own eyes...

dialogues.jp: 「……冷静に考えると、ありえない」
dialogues.en: "...I may not have thought about it calmly."
dialogues.text: "...I may not have thought about it calmly."

dialogues.jp:
そう、自分のその目が信用できないのだから困
りものなのだ。
dialogues.en: Yeah, I don't really have trust in even my own eyes anymore.
dialogues.text: Yeah, I don't really have trust in even my own eyes anymore.

dialogues.jp:
部屋の外で電話が鳴っているのがなんとなく耳
に入ってきたが、どうせ音夢が取ってくれるだ
ろう、と俺は微動だにしなかった。
dialogues.en:
The telephone started ringing outside, but figuring Nemu
would get it, I didn't move one inch.
dialogues.text:
The telephone started ringing outside, but figuring Nemu
would get it, I didn't move one inch.

dialogues.jp: 音夢、遅いな、何やってるんだろ。
dialogues.en: She's slow. What's she doing?
dialogues.text: She's slow. What's she doing?

dialogues.jp: （あ、そうか……あいつは居なかったんだ）
dialogues.en: "(Oh, right... she's not here anymore.)"
dialogues.text: "(Oh, right... she's not here anymore.)"

dialogues.jp:
この暮らしにもいい加減慣れたと思っていたの
だが、人任せにする長年の癖はなかなか抜けな
いものだ。
dialogues.en:
I've relied on other people to do things like that for so
long, I've forgotten that I have to do them myself now.
dialogues.text:
I've relied on other people to do things like that for so
long, I've forgotten that I have to do them myself now.

dialogues.jp: 「かったるいな……」
dialogues.en: "How troublesome..."
dialogues.text: "How troublesome..."

dialogues.jp: 呟きながらむくりと起き上がった。
dialogues.en: I sighed as I got up from bed.
dialogues.text: I sighed as I got up from bed.

dialogues.jp: 「はい、朝倉です」
dialogues.en: "Yes, Asakura speaking."
dialogues.text: "Yes, Asakura speaking."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『あ…………今晩は』
dialogues.en: "H, hi.... good evening."
dialogues.text: "H, hi.... good evening."

dialogues.jp: 声を聞いた瞬間、ドキリ、と心臓が跳ねる。
dialogues.en:
My heartbeat sped up several notches at the sound of the
voice.
dialogues.text:
My heartbeat sped up several notches at the sound of the
voice.

dialogues.jp: 工藤からだった。
dialogues.en: It's Kudou.
dialogues.text: It's Kudou.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、あぁ、今晩は工藤、…………」
dialogues.en: "A, ahh, good evening Kudou..."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh, good evening Kudou..."

dialogues.jp: 挨拶の後おとずれる気まずい沈黙。
dialogues.en: I returned the greeting, and a bout of silence ensued.
dialogues.text: I returned the greeting, and a bout of silence ensued.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『あのさ……今日……見た、よな？』
dialogues.en: "Um.... about today... did you see anything?"
dialogues.text: "Um.... about today... did you see anything?"

dialogues.jp:
その沈黙を｛ふっしょく／払拭｝するように、工藤はそう切り出
した。
dialogues.en: Finally breaking the silence, Kudou started to speak.
dialogues.text: Finally breaking the silence, Kudou started to speak.

dialogues.jp:
「な、何の事だ？　そんな、お前が女の子なん
　て事は……」
dialogues.en:
"W, what thing? You mean, the thing about you being a
girl..."
dialogues.text:
"W, what thing? You mean, the thing about you being a
girl..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "......You saw."
dialogues.text: "......You saw."

dialogues.jp: し、しまった……。
dialogues.en: D, d'oh...
dialogues.text: D, d'oh...

dialogues.jp:
おもいっきり墓穴を掘った俺に、工藤はぶすり
と突っ込んでくる。
dialogues.en: I spoke too directly without thinking again...
dialogues.text: I spoke too directly without thinking again...

dialogues.en: "....Sorry."
dialogues.text: "....Sorry."

dialogues.jp: 俺は小さく謝った。
dialogues.en: I apologized in a tiny voice.
dialogues.text: I apologized in a tiny voice.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『頼む、誰にも言わないでくれないか』
dialogues.en: "Please, don't tell anyone about it."
dialogues.text: "Please, don't tell anyone about it."

dialogues.jp: 電話の向こうの声は切実な調子で訴える。
dialogues.en: Her tone was serious, as she implored me.
dialogues.text: Her tone was serious, as she implored me.

dialogues.jp: 「お前やっぱり……でもなんで」
dialogues.en: "So you really are.... but why?"
dialogues.text: "So you really are.... but why?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は戸惑いつつそう尋ねた。
dialogues.en: All lost at sea, I somehow got my question out.
dialogues.text: All lost at sea, I somehow got my question out.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『それを……話さなきゃ駄目か？』
dialogues.en: "Do I... have to answer that?"
dialogues.text: "Do I... have to answer that?"

dialogues.jp: かすかに困惑の気配。
dialogues.en: That reply made me worry a little.
dialogues.text: That reply made me worry a little.

dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp:
本当に困っているような工藤の声に、俺も口ご
もる。
dialogues.en: I didn't know what to say to Kudou's question.
dialogues.text: I didn't know what to say to Kudou's question.

dialogues.jp: 確かに理由は気になる。
dialogues.en: Apparently the reason is an uncomfortable one for her.
dialogues.text: Apparently the reason is an uncomfortable one for her.

dialogues.jp: 俺は工藤が好きだから、なおの事知りたい。
dialogues.en: But I like her, and I want to know more about her.
dialogues.text: But I like her, and I want to know more about her.

dialogues.jp:
ただの興味本位ではなく、何かできることがあ
ればちからになってやりたいと思う。
dialogues.en:
I'm interested in what's going on, and whether I can help in
any way.
dialogues.text:
I'm interested in what's going on, and whether I can help in
any way.

dialogues.jp:
でもそれより、何より今、こいつを困らせてい
るのは俺だった。
dialogues.en:
Yet at this point, I didn't want to trouble her too much
with questions...
dialogues.text:
Yet at this point, I didn't want to trouble her too much
with questions...

dialogues.jp: 「工藤、俺さ……」
dialogues.en: "Kudou, I..."
dialogues.text: "Kudou, I..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『……分かった。明日……桜公園まで来てくれ
　ないか？　そのときに全部話すよ』
dialogues.en:
"...Alright. Tomorrow... can you go to the Sakura Park? I'd
explain everything there."
dialogues.text:
"...Alright. Tomorrow... can you go to the Sakura Park? I'd
explain everything there."

dialogues.jp:
言いかけた言葉は思いつめたような声にかき消
された。
dialogues.en: Her quick response left me at a loss for words.
dialogues.text: Her quick response left me at a loss for words.

dialogues.jp:
それから、何を話したのかは覚えていない。気
がつくと俺は汗ばんだ手で受話器を握り締め、
ツーツーという単調な音を聴いていた。
dialogues.en:
I'd completely forgotten what I wanted to say. My sweaty
hand was gripping the receiver tightly, until just a dial
tone remained.
dialogues.text:
I'd completely forgotten what I wanted to say. My sweaty
hand was gripping the receiver tightly, until just a dial
tone remained.

dialogues.jp: ゆっくりと受話器を戻す。
dialogues.en: I put the receiver back on it's place.
dialogues.text: I put the receiver back on it's place.

dialogues.jp: 工藤は何を話してくれるのだろう。
dialogues.en: What's she going to tell me tomorrow...
dialogues.text: What's she going to tell me tomorrow...

dialogues.jp: ◆工藤からの電話◆
dialogues.en: ◆A Call from Kudou◆
dialogues.text: ◆A Call from Kudou◆

dialogues.jp: その夜、工藤から電話がかかってきた。
dialogues.en: That night, I received a call from Kudou.
dialogues.text: That night, I received a call from Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
男装の理由を尋ねる俺に、工藤は明日、桜公
園で、全てを話すと言うのだった。
dialogues.en:
When I asked her why she disguised herself as a man, she
said that she'd explain everything at the Sakura Park
tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
When I asked her why she disguised herself as a man, she
said that she'd explain everything at the Sakura Park
tomorrow.

dialogues.jp:
工藤の、その思いつめたような声がいつまで
も俺の耳に残った。
dialogues.en: Leaving that thought behind, her voice left my ears.
dialogues.text: Leaving that thought behind, her voice left my ears.
